paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search Using a Josephson Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
notes: ADMX sidecar cavity haloscope using JTWPA. Excludes axion-photon coupling above ~1e-13 GeV^-1 over 4796.7-4799.5 MHz (~19.84 ueV). Only an approximate single bound is given in text; the exact exclusion curve in Fig 7 is not numerically tabulated. DM density 0.45 GeV/cc assumed. Mass ~1.984e-5 eV from 4.798 GHz.
